tasks.description: A member can borrow a seed packet from the library catalog.

acceptance_criteria.text: The borrow endpoint marks the seed packet as on loan to the member when the member is in good standing
A member holding six packets who borrows another is refused and the message names the limit of six
The catalog search result lists the due date for packets on loan
Borrowing records the librarian who handed the packet over
Two borrow requests for the sixth and the seventh packet of one member made at the same moment cannot both succeed
Borrowing past the limit returns HTTP 409 with the code limit-reached

tasks.description: A member can return a borrowed seed packet at the desk or the drop box.

acceptance_criteria.text: Closing a loan at the desk makes the returned packet available again
A loan closed after its due date records the number of overdue days on the member's account
Volunteers scan the packet label to confirm a drop box return
The drop box is emptied every evening by the closing volunteer
Closing a loan at the desk completes in under one second for ninety-five requests in a hundred

tasks.description: A grower can donate saved seed to the library with notes on the variety.

acceptance_criteria.text: Submitting the donation form with variety name and year creates a donation record awaiting review
Approving a donation adds a packet to the catalog and credits the donating grower
A donation naming a species on the restricted list is rejected
Donation forms are available in large print at the desk

tasks.description: A member can renew their annual membership online.

acceptance_criteria.text: A payment of the renewal fee by a member within thirty days of expiry moves the expiry date forward by one year
A declined card leaves the membership as it was and shows the member the decline reason
The receipt email is sent once the payment has cleared
Renewal reminders go out sixty days before expiry

tasks.description: A member can record germination results for a borrowed variety.

acceptance_criteria.text: Germination counts submitted by a member with a returned loan are attached to the variety page
Sprouted counts above sown counts are rejected with a validation message
The variety page shows the average germination rate over all results
Germination photos are resized to fit the variety page

tasks.description: A volunteer can sign up for desk shifts.

acceptance_criteria.text: Signing up for an open desk shift lists the volunteer on it and reduces the open count by one
A cancellation made more than a day before reopens the shift
A late cancellation notifies the coordinator
Shift lists are sorted by date

tasks.description: The library runs a spring plant sale with a list of seedlings.

acceptance_criteria.text: The seedling list is published on the public page when the sale opens
Seedlings with no stock remaining are marked sold out on the list
The order total applies the member discount when the visitor is a member
Seedling photos load lazily

tasks.description: A member can book a place at a seed-saving workshop.

acceptance_criteria.text: Booking a workshop with free places holds a place and shows a confirmation
A member trying to book a full workshop is offered the waiting list
A cancelled place is given to the first person on the waiting list
Workshop dates display in the member's time zone
The joining time of the waiting list decides who is offered a freed place first

tasks.description: A librarian can mark a packet as lost and charge the member.

acceptance_criteria.text: Marking an overdue packet lost after sixty days charges the member the replacement fee
Reversing the loss of a returned packet refunds the replacement fee
Lost packets are hidden from catalog search
The replacement fee is set by the board each January

tasks.description: Members receive a monthly newsletter by email.

acceptance_criteria.text: The monthly send emails the newsletter to every member who has opted in
A member who unsubscribed is skipped by the next send
Members whose address bounced are flagged for the librarians after the send
Newsletter issues are archived on the public page

tasks.description: Housekeeping for the season

acceptance_criteria.text: The board slide deck is exported as a PDF
The deck lists the three budget scenarios

tasks.description: Visitors can browse the catalog by plant family.

acceptance_criteria.text: Picking a plant family lists only the packets of that family
A family with no packets shows an empty-state message that suggests the donation form
The next twenty packets are loaded when the visitor scrolls past the first twenty
Picking a plant family on the donation form lists the families a donor can donate in

tasks.description: The library prints a label for every packet with its variety and sowing season.

acceptance_criteria.text: Printing a packet label shows the variety name and the sowing season
Scanning a label at the desk opens the packet record
A variety with no sowing season prints a label with the season line blank
Printing a donation receipt shows the variety name and the year the grower donated it

tasks.description: Members with overdue packets receive reminders.

acceptance_criteria.text: The nightly job emails a reminder to the member of a loan that is one day overdue
A loan fourteen days overdue gets a second reminder and notifies a librarian
No reminder is sent for a loan that has been returned
The nightly job emails the treasurer the total of the fees charged that day

tasks.description: Donating growers can have a public profile page.

acceptance_criteria.text: A grower with an approved donation who enables a profile gets a public page that lists the donated varieties
Requesting the page of a disabled profile returns not found
The profile page shows neither an email address nor a phone number
A grower who enables their newsletter subscription receives the monthly newsletter by email

tasks.description: Volunteers check packets out to members at the desk with a barcode scanner.

acceptance_criteria.text: Scanning a member card and a packet label creates the loan and shows the due date on the desk screen
An expired member card blocks the loan and the desk screen shows the expiry date
Typing the packet code creates the loan the same way as a scan
Scanning a member card at the desk shows the member's name on the screen
Two desks scanning the same packet label at the same moment create one loan only

tasks.description: Members can search varieties by name or by a growing trait.

acceptance_criteria.text: Typing part of a variety name lists the matching varieties with their packet counts
Picking the drought tolerance trait lists only varieties with that trait
A search with no result offers the donation request form to the member
Typing part of a volunteer's name in the roster lists the matching volunteers
The first page of search results arrives in under 800 milliseconds for ninety-five searches in a hundred

tasks.description: The library hosts a yearly seed swap where members trade packets.

acceptance_criteria.text: Registration opens on the swap date and lets members register with the count of packets they will bring
The volunteer checks an arriving member in against the registration list
Closing the event adds the leftover packets to the catalog
Registration for a workshop opens when the workshop is published

tasks.description: A librarian can waive fees for a member in hardship.

acceptance_criteria.text: Granting a waiver with a reason clears the outstanding fees of the member
A granted waiver records the librarian and the reason on the account
Submitting a waiver without a reason is rejected
The librarian can print a statement of the fees charged to a member
Waiving more than the balance leaves the fee balance at zero, never below it

tasks.description: Donors can add a photo of the plant to a packet record.

acceptance_criteria.text: A photo uploaded by a librarian appears on the packet page
A photo over five megabytes is rejected and the message gives the size limit
Uploading a file that is not an image is rejected
A photo of the library building appears on the public home page
Uploading a six megabyte photo returns HTTP 413 with the code photo-too-large

tasks.description: The board receives an annual report of loans and donations.

acceptance_criteria.text: The generated report lists the number of loans and the number of donations for the year
Each figure in the report is compared with the figure of the year before
A year without donations shows a donation figure of zero rather than leaving it out
The board receives a monthly summary of the number of new members

tasks.description: Donated seed is held in quarantine before it joins the catalog.

acceptance_criteria.text: A packet created from an approved donation is held in quarantine for fourteen days and cannot be borrowed
Catalog search shows a packet in quarantine with the date it will become available
The nightly job makes a packet available for loan once its quarantine has ended
The quarantine shelf is cleaned every Friday by the closing volunteer

tasks.description: Members can opt in to a directory of local growers.

acceptance_criteria.text: The directory page lists the first name and neighbourhood of a member who opted in
A member who opted out no longer appears on the directory page
A message to a grower is relayed without revealing either email address
The directory page can be printed as a flyer for the notice board

tasks.description: Attendees can leave feedback after a workshop.

acceptance_criteria.text: An attendee of a workshop that has ended can rate it from one to five and add a comment on the feedback form
Opening the form again shows the earlier answer of an attendee who already left feedback for editing
The organiser's summary lists the average rating and the comments of the workshop
Workshop organisers can duplicate last year's workshop as a draft

tasks.description: Housekeeping for the season

acceptance_criteria.text: The static site is deployed over HTTPS
The deploy job posts its result in the volunteers chat
